ch.epfl.biop.imaris

Class EasyXT.Scene

  • java.lang.Object
    • ch.epfl.biop.imaris.EasyXT.Scene
  • Enclosing class:
    EasyXT

    public static class EasyXT.Scene
extends Object
    This class handles all queries to the surpass scene and to its related Items Method to find spots, surfaces, groups, or arbitrary objects are found inside Methods to get or set item names
